# Advocate Akash R. Chikate & Associates
# Criminal Defence Law Firm — Pune, Maharashtra, India
# https://advocateakashchikate.com

## About
Advocate Akash R. Chikate is a criminal defence lawyer based in Shivajinagar, Pune, practicing before the Bombay High Court, Pune District & Sessions Court, Family Court, and Consumer Court. He has 8+ years of courtroom experience, an LLM in Science & Technology Laws (First Class Distinction), and a Diploma in Cyber Laws.

## Practice Areas
- Anticipatory Bail (Section 482, BNSS 2023) — Pune Sessions Court & Bombay High Court
- Regular Bail (Section 483, BNSS 2023) — all court levels
- FIR Quashing (Section 528, BNSS) — Bombay High Court
- Criminal Defence & Trial — Sessions Court, Pune
- NDPS / Drug Case Defence — bail under Section 37, FSL challenge
- Cybercrime Defence — IT Act, Section 66, online fraud, Pune Cyber Cell
- MCOCA Defence — Bombay High Court
- POCSO Defence — Sessions Court
- 498A / Domestic Violence Defence
- Cheque Bounce (Section 138 NI Act)
- Mutual Consent Divorce — Pune Family Court (including NRI / overseas cases)
- Child Custody & Maintenance
- POSH Act Compliance & Advisory
- Corporate Criminal Advisory
- Intellectual Property — trademark, copyright, patent
